item.title: Version 1.0
item.description:
Textlore 1.0

The first version of Textlore: find anything in your iMessage history in seconds.

  • Search every message as you type, by person, date, group or photo.
  • Quick search from any app with Option-Space.
  • Every photo and file people sent you, by person and month.
  • Export conversations to PDF, HTML, text, Markdown, CSV or an image.
  • A local archive that keeps messages and photos after Messages clears them.
  • Your Lore: your messaging life as tree rings, with share cards.
  • Ask AI, answered on your Mac with Apple Intelligence.

Everything stays on your Mac. Textlore only reads.
